situation: Home from work at 7, exhausted, cold beer in the fridge, game starts at 8

temptations.text: I deserve a beer — I've had a hard day.

response.text: I do deserve good things — including sleeping well and liking myself tomorrow morning. The game is fun either way; when I drink I usually doze off and miss it anyway.

temptations.text: I'll just have a couple, that can't hurt.

response.text: 'Just a couple' has literally never happened. Tonight the answer is simply no, and the urge will pass in a few minutes.

notes: Did a short Devil's Advocate round — crushed both. Moved the beer to the garage (stimulus control).
